The helper preserves cleanup failures through exception notes at [artifacts.py:208](</C:/Users/Shuhei Yokkaichi/Documents/CFD/P4P_mcp_contributions/PyAnsys/src/pyansys_fluent/mcp_additions/artifacts.py:208>). Pinned upstream puts those notes in the traceback in `stderr`, while `message` contains `str(exc)`. Thus, an export failure combined with a cleanup failure hides the cleanup error from the agent. Leftover objects, settings or blocking files can then go unreported. Return both diagnostics, or a structured cleanup receipt. This is a static finding; the saved run does not exercise it.

The three prior repairs are present: cache invalidation runs in `finally`; graphics cleanup actions run independently; native outputs use private scratch files and exclusive publication with rollback.

I verified the saved source-pair, PNG, view and metadata hashes. The returned MCP image matches the saved PNG, which I also viewed.

The addition has useful scope beyond upstream screenshots and simulation reports: explicit field and surfaces, fixed limits, camera data, source hashes and image content in one operation. It keeps upstream session ownership and locking. Replacing unsaved state is explicit.
